# Tenant & infrastructure
{: .no_toc }

Where an Application owner's data lives, and support-run tier changes. Tenants aren't billed.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `BIL-04` |
| **Route** | `/dev/tenant` · deep link `substratal://dev/tenant` |
| **Where** | Developer › Tenant |
| **Who can use it** | Tenant owner (read), tenants.manage (write) |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | Content pane; `AdwViewSwitcher`; header-bar actions |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Facts | key-value | Tenant: tier, region, status, owner, application_count | status migrating → banner, writes may 503 | AdwActionRow subtitle |
| Tier change requests | list | TenantTierChangeRequest: from→requested tier/region, status, scheduled_for, reason, notes |  | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Request change | button | → form: requested_tier, requested_region, reason | tenants.manage only; owners see "isolated and dedicated-region tiers come with business pricing — contact sales" | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Open request | `POST /tenants/{id}/tier-change-requests` | 422/409 errors |
| Open request detail | `GET /tenants/{id}/tier-change-requests/{requestId}` | polls every 30 s while visible |
| Advance request | `PATCH /tenants/{id}/tier-change-requests/{requestId} {status, scheduled_for, notes} (If-Match)` | staff only; status scheduled → in_progress → completed, or cancelled |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /tenants` · `GET /tenants/{id}` · `GET /tenants/{id}/tier-change-requests`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
